intro: Lucy Jane Cakes is a cake maker whose TikTok bio gives London as its base and whose baker PEOPLE has called a buttercream specialist. Its videos show heart, character, photo and bento cakes; orders are taken by Instagram message.
about: In February 2025 PEOPLE reported that she had baked her entire life and began selling cakes professionally in 2016. The same article reported that she made seven cakes for her own wedding in London on 7 December 2024: a three-tier classic vanilla sponge as the main cake and six others, each a different flavour, with all seven finished two days before the wedding. She also told the story of making them in a TikTok video.

Alongside finished cakes, the TikTok account @lucy_jane_cakes has posted baking and decorating how-to videos. These include a photo-cake tutorial that names the Wilton 199 and Jen 2ES nozzles she used, along with tips on getting a level rise in 6-inch PME tins and on freezing leftover cake slices.

Her video captions use hashtags for both London and Essex, including #londoncakes, #lambethcake, #southwoodford and #essexcakes. Lucy Jane Cakes does not appear to have its own website and publishes no prices. Its TikTok bio says 'Message on Instagram for orders', and the account to message about an event cake is @lucy_jane_cakes.

services.name: Buttercream cakes
services.description: PEOPLE has called the baker 'the buttercream specialist behind Lucy Jane Cakes' and reported that she began selling cakes professionally in 2016. No prices are published.

services.name: Heart cakes
services.description: A TikTok video captioned 'ALL THE PINKS' and tagged #heartcake has a cover showing a two-tier smooth pink cake on a turntable. The caption credits the toppers to an outside supplier.

services.name: Themed and character cakes
services.description: Her videos show themed and character designs. Examples are a red and blue Spider-Man buttercream cake posted in May 2024 and a cowgirl cake with disco-ball decorations from March 2025.

services.name: Photo cakes
services.description: She has posted a how-to video on making a photo cake, which names the Wilton 199 and Jen 2ES nozzles she used.

services.name: Bento cakes
services.description: Small bento cakes appear in a 'Bento Love' TikTok video from March 2025, tagged #bentocake and #londoncake.

established.label: Began selling cakes professionally in 2016, according to PEOPLE

identity.note: An older directory listing gives Essex and a founding year of 2014, but the TikTok bio says London and PEOPLE reports that she began selling cakes professionally in 2016; the Lucy Jane Cake Company in Milton Keynes is a different business.
